These are the red/blue private-field multiplications. A numeric type guard on the private-field expression optimizes them, but the guard's runtime check makes the compiler drop the Math/floor global facts for guarded lines after the check. Measured on brightness: 3 guards -> 11/15 optimized, 4 Math/floor loads deoptimized; 1 guard (93:30) -> 13/15 optimized. Measured on toString: 3 guards -> 8/15 optimized; 1 guard (101:30) -> 10/15 optimized. Single guard per function retained: optimizing these 2 multiplications costs 4 property loads, a net loss.
